core_obligations: Represent K by a bounded complex F-bullet of coherent O_U-modules, zero outside [a, b].
Since j is quasi-compact and separated, j_*F-bullet is a bounded complex of quasi-coherent O_X-modules.

Inductively build coherent submodules G^i of j_*F^i: for i = a pick any coherent submodule restricting to F^a (Properties extend lemma); for i > a pick H^i with H^i|_U = F^i and set G^i = image of H^i + G^{i-1} -> j_*F^i.
Each G^i restricts to F^i on U; conclude G-bullet is a bounded complex of coherent O_X-modules with G-bullet|_U = F-bullet, representing an extension of K.
proof_roadmap: Bounded coherent representative; pushforward quasi-coherence; inductive submodule construction; restriction verification.
difficulty_reason: An inductive extension construction with a degree-by-degree image bookkeeping; short and genuine.
